/* 대시보드 내업무Todo, 진행업무별 현재상태 조회 CSPD001TM - 심사 마스터 테이블 CSPD112TI - 심사 코드 테이블 AI_INPT_ACVT_CD - 심사 활동코드 AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM - 심사 공통코드명 AI_INPT_GRP_CD - 심사 그룹코드(290 - 액티비티) AI_INSPE_ENO - 심사 직원번호 AI_INPT_SNPE_ENO - 심사 결재자 직원번호 QLAS_SNPE_ENO - 품질보증 결재자 직원번호 INPT_RCP_DT - 심사 접수일자 */ SELECT A.ACVT_CD, A.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM, SUM(NVL(B.TOTAL_CNT, 0)) AS TOTAL_CNT FROM ( /* 액티비티 코드, 액티비티 코드명 */ SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD AS ACVT_CD, AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '290'
AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD IN ('80', '90')
AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD IN ('100', '130', '140', '160')
AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD IN ('100', '120')
AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD IN ('90', '110', '140', '160')
AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD IN ('110')
AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD IN('120', '160')
ORDER BY AI_INPT_CMN_CD )A, ( /* 사용자 권한 항목별 업무 수 */
SELECT COUNT(INPT_MST_SRNO) AS TOTAL_CNT, AI_INPT_ACVT_CD AS ACVT_CD FROM CSPD001TM WHERE AI_INSPE_ENO = #{userId}
AND INPT_RCP_DT <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN ('80', '90') AND PAPS_RE_SCAN_NED_YN IS NULL
AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') = INPT_RCP_DT AND AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN ('130', '140', '100', '160')
GROUP BY AI_INPT_ACVT_CD
SELECT COUNT(INPT_MST_SRNO) AS TOTAL_CNT, AI_INPT_ACVT_CD AS ACVT_CD FROM CSPD001TM WHERE AI_INPT_SNPE_ENO = #{userId} AND QLAS_PRG_YN IS NULL
AND INPT_RCP_DT <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN ('100')
AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') = INPT_RCP_DT AND AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN ('90', '140', '160')
GROUP BY AI_INPT_ACVT_CD
UNION
SELECT COUNT(INPT_MST_SRNO) AS TOTAL_CNT, AI_INPT_QLAS_ACVT_CD AS ACVT_CD FROM CSPD001TM WHERE QLAS_SNPE_ENO = #{userId} AND QLAS_PRG_YN = 'Y'
AND INPT_RCP_DT <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND AI_INPT_QLAS_ACVT_CD IN ('120')
AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') = INPT_RCP_DT AND AI_INPT_QLAS_ACVT_CD IN ('110', '140', '160')
GROUP BY AI_INPT_QLAS_ACVT_CD
SELECT COUNT(INPT_MST_SRNO) AS TOTAL_CNT, AI_INPT_QLAS_ACVT_CD AS ACVT_CD FROM CSPD001TM WHERE QLAS_CRPE_ENO = #{userId}
AND QLAS_ALOC_DT <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND AI_INPT_QLAS_ACVT_CD IN ('110')
AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') = QLAS_ALOC_DT AND AI_INPT_QLAS_ACVT_CD IN('120', '160')
GROUP BY AI_INPT_QLAS_ACVT_CD
)B WHERE A.ACVT_CD = B.ACVT_CD(+) GROUP BY A.ACVT_CD, A.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM

/* 대시보드 내업무Todo, 진행업무별 현재상태 조회 CSPD001TM - 심사 마스터 테이블 AI_INPT_ACVT_CD - 심사 활동코드 AI_INPT_QLAS_ACVT_CD - QA 공통코드명 */ SELECT * FROM /* 당일심사목록 */ ( SELECT RESULT AS TOTAL_CNT, '당일심사목록' AS AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM, '1' AS RNK FROM ( SELECT A.A_COUNT + B.B_COUNT AS RESULT FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS A_COUNT FROM CSPD201TM A WHERE 1=1 AND A.XPO_CVRG_MTBR_MK_DT = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND ((( A.FX_ACNO, A.XPO_CVRG_MK_SQ ) IN ( SELECT ACTL_FX_REFNO, FX_REFNO_SRNO FROM CSPD001TM WHERE ACTL_FX_REFNO = A.FX_ACNO AND FX_REFNO_SRNO = A.XPO_CVRG_MK_SQ ) AND A.INPT_ATMC_REQ_DSCD = '3') OR (A.INPT_ATMC_REQ_DSCD != '3')) ) A, ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS B_COUNT FROM CSPD202TM A WHERE 1=1 AND A.TDOC_RCP_DT = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND ((( A.FX_ACNO, A.TDOC_RCP_SRNO ) IN ( SELECT ACTL_FX_REFNO, FX_REFNO_SRNO FROM CSPD001TM WHERE ACTL_FX_REFNO = A.FX_ACNO AND FX_REFNO_SRNO = A.TDOC_RCP_SRNO ) AND A.INPT_ATMC_REQ_DSCD = '3') OR (A.INPT_ATMC_REQ_DSCD != '3')) ) B ) ) UNION /* 당일심사진행 */ ( SELECT TOTAL AS TOTAL_CNT, '당일심사진행' AS AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM, '2' AS RNK FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL FROM CSPD001TM WHERE INPT_RCP_DT = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AND AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN('130','140','160') ) ) UNION /* 당일QA목록 */ ( SELECT CNT01 AS TOTAL_CNT, '당일QA목록' AS AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM, '3' AS RNK FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT01 FROM CSPD001TM WHERE QLAS_PRG_YN = 'Y' AND QLAS_ALOC_DT = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') ) ) UNION /* 당일QA진행 */ ( SELECT CNT01 AS TOTAL_CNT, '당일QA진행' AS AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM, '3' AS RNK FROM (
SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT01 FROM CSPD001TM WHERE QLAS_PRG_YN = 'Y' AND AI_INPT_QLAS_ACVT_CD IN ('140', '160') AND QLAS_ALOC_DT = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') ) ) ORDER BY RNK

/* 국가별 수출입 현황 */ WITH VW_TASK1 AS ( /* 통계대상 심사업무 목록 */ SELECT A.INPT_MST_SRNO, A.INPT_SANCTION_NO AS SANCTION_NO, /* 심사제재항목코드 */ B.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM AS SANCTION_NAME, /* 심사제재항목이름 */ A.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT, /* 추출용어 */ C.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD /* 업무구분코드 (1 - 수입, 2 - 수출) */ FROM CSPD004TF A, /* 항목심사결과상세 테이블 */ ( /* 수출,수입에 대한 Sanction 항목에 대한 정보 */ SELECT A.AI_INPT_GRP_CD, A.AI_INPT_GRP_NM, B.AI_INPT_CMN_CD, B.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM, B.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM FROM CSPD111TI A, CSPD112TI B WHERE A.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = B.AI_INPT_GRP_CD AND B.AI_INPT_CMN_CD = '18' /* X축 검색 선택박스 선택값 - 값있을때만 적용 */ AND B.AI_INPT_CMN_CD IN ( SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '350' AND AI_INPT_CMN_USG_YN = 'Y' ) /* 국가관련 심사제재코드만 필터링 */ ) B, CSPD001TM C WHERE TO_CHAR(A.INPT_SANCTION_NO) = B.AI_INPT_CMN_CD AND A.INPT_MST_SRNO = C.INPT_MST_SRNO AND A.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT IS NOT NULL AND C.INPT_RCP_DT = #{inptRcpDt} ), VW_TASK AS ( /* 통계대상 심사업무 목록에서, 국가정보 추가 */ SELECT A.* , B.NACD , B.ENG_NL_NM AS NA_ENM , B.KORL_NL_NM AS NA_KNM , A.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT AS TXT FROM VW_TASK1 A, CSPD115TI B WHERE A.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT = B.NACD(+) ) SELECT A.* FROM ( /* 항목별 심사업무 카운팅 */ SELECT A.TXT, COUNT(*) AS CNT , MAX(A.NACD) AS NACD /* 국가코드 */ , MAX(A.NA_ENM) AS ENG_NL_NM /* 국가명(영문) */ , MAX(A.NA_KNM) AS KOR_NL_NM /* 국가명(한글) */ , SUM(CASE A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD WHEN '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS IMPORT_CNT , SUM(CASE A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD WHEN '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS EXPORT_CNT FROM ( /* 항목별로 심사업무 중복제거 */ SELECT A.INPT_MST_SRNO, A.TXT , MAX(A.NACD) AS NACD , MAX(A.NA_ENM) AS NA_ENM , MAX(A.NA_KNM) AS NA_KNM , MAX(A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD) AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD FROM VW_TASK A GROUP BY A.INPT_MST_SRNO, A.TXT ) A GROUP BY A.TXT ) A WHERE A.CNT > 0 ORDER BY A.CNT DESC
